title: PTGui Tutorial Part 2 — Main Window, Panorama Editor, and Create Panorama
summary: This PTGui tutorial (Pro edition highlighted) introduces the main window user interface, contrasts PTGui with PTGui Pro, and demonstrates a quick panorama build from a set of images. It covers dragging images, using EXIF data for camera/lens inference, automatically aligning images, and opening the Panorama Editor. The video then walks through editing modes, levelling, and projection options, followed by trimming and viewing seams. It finishes with the Create Panorama tab, including output size optimization, export formats (JPEG vs Photoshop with layers), and common blending controls (Feather, Interpolator) along with how including or excluding images affects the final panorama. Tone mapping is noted as a separate topic for future tutorials.
